entry.title: GitHub Copilot App v1.1.31
entry.summary:
What's new in v1.1.31
Highlights
- Assisted approvals is now available to everyone, approving requests an automatic safety check deems safe and prompting you otherwise. - Select multiple sessions in an agent's Overview tab, then archive, delete, mark as read, or open them in a grid together. - Edit a whole file directly from the All changes or Uncommitted changes diff. - WSL hosts are now enabled by default on Windows, letting you discover WSL distributions and create sessions inside them. -

entry.title: GitHub Copilot App v1.1.29
entry.summary:
What's new in v1.1.29
Highlights
- Background shell tasks now continuously show their latest output in the task detail view for local sessions. - "Open URL from clipboard" is now available in the Command Palette. - Opening a pull request or issue link no longer requires cloning its repository. - Selecting a subfolder of a repository now starts sessions in that subfolder, so package-specific instructions and skills are applied. - Restored creating cloud automations, including repository-event

entry.title: GitHub Copilot App v1.1.27
entry.summary:
What's new in v1.1.27
Highlights
- Added version history to the artifact editor, so you can view and preview previous versions of an edited artifact. - WSL sessions now show images and file edits returned by tool calls directly in the conversation, including expandable diffs. - You can now resume an interrupted coordinator agent and its child sessions directly from the sidebar. - Video attachments now appear alongside images in the conversation's media grid, with preview and playback support.
